offline_simulation.method: zero-model, oracle-free: each frozen v01-v06 task wording as a plain query (all-terms then any-term fallback, 25% floor), production diversify, first N records; 'class' restricts to project/experience source kinds (github+folder) or to study notes for the study-subject task; v06 unrestricted
offline_simulation.pair_definition: >=2 audited pool entities present (v06: >=1 project and >=1 subject)

hypotheses.H_class_scoping: rejected as standalone lever: 5/21 full vs 5/21 class at the observed packet; +0-1 task with a pair at depth 20-30
hypotheses.H_packet_depth: monotonic but capped: 5/21 at 7 records to 13/21 at 40 records (about 5x units); at most 4/6 tasks with a pool pair before any selection or grounding loss; one task never reached lexically at any depth
hypotheses.H_inventory: not retested: the 2026-10-07 real B roster already listed all 11 repositories; Evidence-stage recall stayed 2/6 and correct pairs did not improve

limitations: Burned v01-v06 tasks used as development cases only; plain task wording is a mechanical proxy for an Agent query; pool is a minimum audited set, not exhaustive; no live session, no grader; presence in a packet is necessary, not sufficient, for an eligible supported selection.
